recent_posts.title: CloudNative.Now
recent_posts.summary: The April 2026 edition of CloudNative.Now covers the Kubernetes v1.36 (Haru) release with 70 enhancements, security vulnerabilities including a critical GitHub RCE (CVE-2026-3854) and a Kubernetes CSI SMB path traversal CVE, migration guides from ingress-nginx to Gateway API, Giant Swarm's live migration to Cluster API, GitHub's use of eBPF for deployment safety, Terragrunt v1.0.0 release, and new tools like kdash and kubectl-snapshot. Also includes KubeCon EU 2026 highlights, upcoming events with discount codes, and CFP deadlines for cloud native conferences.

recent_posts.title: CloudNative.Now
recent_posts.summary: March 2026 edition of CloudNative.Now covers KubeCon EU 2026 highlights, the retirement of Ingress-NGINX and migration paths to Gateway API, multiple high-severity CVEs in ingress-nginx and Kubernetes CSI drivers, a supply chain attack on Trivy, Kubernetes v1.36 sneak peek, Velero's donation to CNCF, and a roundup of new tools including Grafana 12.4, k8s-cleaner, and terrapod.

recent_posts.title: CloudNative.Now
recent_posts.summary: The February 2026 edition of CloudNative.Now covers key happenings in the cloud-native ecosystem. Highlights include the OpenTelemetry batch processor deprecation in favor of exporter-level batching, the shutdown of Kubernetes Ingress NGINX in March 2026 with Gateway API migration guidance, Red Hat's enterprise Podman Desktop competing with Docker Desktop, and the official end of Heroku. Tool releases include Kyverno 1.17 with a stabilized CEL policy engine and Flux 2.8 GA with Helm v4 support. The newsletter also covers a new Cilium book from Isovalent, a Node Readiness Controller for complex Kubernetes bootstrapping, multiple ingress-nginx CVEs, and upcoming events including KubeCon Amsterdam and Cloud Native Rejekts.
